crossword.title: Crossword Puzzle
crossword.description: Fill in Korean words using across and down clues in this crossword puzzle game.
crossword.hint: Tap a cell and type in Korean. Tap the same cell again or press Space to switch direction, Tab for the next word, arrows to move.

guide.title: How to Play
items: A numbered daily puzzle is released every midnight (KST). Everyone gets the same puzzle, so you can compare times
Tap a cell to show its clue above the grid; use ‹ › to move between words
Letters being composed appear in the cell right away, and the cursor advances after each syllable
Tap the same cell again or press Space to switch across/down; Tab jumps to the next word
Each check (letter/word/all) or reveal (letter/word) counts as one hint
Progress is saved automatically; only your first daily solve is recorded
After solving, share your '#number time · hints' result as an image or text
